Cross Math with automatic Liquid Glass, Material 3 and Fluent interfaces.

- Windows x64: `.exe` installer or `.msi`.
- Linux x64: `.AppImage` or `.deb`.
- macOS: `.dmg` for Apple Silicon or Intel.

Manual UI selection is available in Settings. Puzzle packs and generated games work offline. Use swipe gestures or arrows to change areas; filled cells can be cleared with the red delete button.

`SHA256SUMS` lists installer checksums. These installers are unsigned; operating systems may ask for confirmation when opening them.
